name: Image Style Preview
project_description: Renders a preview of every image style derivative on the canonical page of an image media entity, so content editors can see what each configured image style actually produces without reading effect descriptions one by one. On the media page it replaces the default image-field output with a set of collapsible details elements — one per image style plus the original — each showing the styled image and a summary of its effects, preceded by an anchor-link index. A small admin settings form (admin/config/media/image-styles/imagestyles) lets you choose which styles are expanded by default. Requires core's Image and Media modules and Standalone media URLs, although the .info.yml does not declare these dependencies.
